title: FoldQuantVLA: Native Low-Bit Quantization of Vision-Language-Action Models via Consistent Folding
abstract: arXiv:2609.24433v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Low-bit vision-language-action inference must reduce observation-to-action latency while preserving robot behavior. We present FoldQuantVLA, a post-training quantization framework that carries a consistent activation representation through calibration, weight rounding, and native integer execution. It combines channel scaling and block Hadamard transforms with dynamic per-token quantization, without policy retraining. Custom TensorRT plugins execute projections in both the language backbone and iterative action expert with four-bit weights and activations (W4A4) on Ada GPUs and Jetson AGX Orin. Evaluation spans LIBERO, SimplerEnv, and two robot platforms. Across three GR00T checkpoints and $\pi_{0.5}$, W4A4 achieves $1.20$ to $1.33\times$ speedups over floating-point TensorRT on Orin and $1.25$ to $1.52\times$ on desktop. Retaining language attention-output and feed-forward down projections at eight bits (W8A8) improves held-out action

translated_title: FoldQuantVLA：通过一致性折叠实现视觉-语言-动作模型的原生低比特量化
translated_abstract: 低比特视觉-语言-动作（VLA）推理需要在保持机器人行为的同时降低从观测到动作的延迟。我们提出了FoldQuantVLA，这是一个后训练量化框架，在校准、权重取整和原生整数执行的整个过程中保持一致的激活表示。该框架将通道缩放和分块Hadamard变换与动态逐token量化相结合，且无需策略重训练。定制的TensorRT插件在Ada GPU和Jetson AGX Orin上以四比特权重和激活（W4A4）执行语言主干和迭代动作专家中的投影计算。评估涵盖LIBERO、SimplerEnv以及两个机器人平台。在三个GR00T检查点和π₀.₅上，W4A4相比浮点TensorRT在Orin上实现了1.20至1.33倍的加速，在桌面平台上实现了1.25至1.52倍的加速。将语言注意力输出和前馈下投影保留为八比特（W8A8）可提升留出动作任务的表现（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 提出FoldQuantVLA后训练量化框架，通过一致性折叠技术将通道缩放、分块Hadamard变换与动态逐token量化相结合，实现VLA模型无需重训练的原生W4A4低比特部署，在Orin和桌面GPU上分别获得最高1.33倍和1.52倍的推理加速。
en_tdlr: FoldQuantVLA is a post-training quantization framework that enables native W4A4 low-bit deployment of vision-language-action models without retraining by combining channel scaling, block Hadamard transforms, and dynamic per-token quantization under a consistent activation representation, achieving up to 1.33x and 1.52x inference speedups on Orin and desktop GPUs respectively.
